This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.866/2022, registered at Police Station-Ashta, District Sehore (MP) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 506 and 34 of Indian Penal Code and 5/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.
